summary: SCALE at GMI Cloud is a 6-week equity-free startup program for AI-native teams, focused on infrastructure, inference, and real-world scale. The official page advertises up to $40K+ in structured credits: $500 MaaS credits on acceptance, 1:1 credit matching up to $4,500, 20% off dedicated endpoints, and partner credits. Cohort 03 (Spring 2027, Mar-May) applications are open; the deadline is TBA, and Cohort 3 credit terms will be confirmed before kickoff. No equity, no fees.
claim_steps: Open the SCALE at GMI Cloud page
Click 'Apply to Cohort 3' and submit the application
If accepted, receive $500 MaaS credits on acceptance
